evals.prompt: 把这个项目的单文件 CLI bug 修好，brief 已写在 fix.md；我只需要它改代码。你会怎么派单和验收？
evals.expected_output: Choose fleet code fix.md --low --cwd <project> --expect-changes for a bounded single-file fix; keep the brief limited to the requested change, then inspect its result and diff without adding unrequested tests or a commit.
checks: 包含 fleet code、--low、--expect-changes
不建议擅自补测试、提交或发布
以结果文件和实际 diff 验收

evals.prompt: 产品页英文文案和日文翻译放在 copy.md 里，请用便宜模型做完。
evals.expected_output: Route copy and translation through fleet copy copy.md, require positive wording and verify the delivered text against the brief.
checks: 选择 fleet copy copy.md
不派 fleet code 写面向读者的文案
要求正面表述并核对交付内容

evals.prompt: 我有 state.txt 和 questions.json，想自动判断客服消息是否紧急、应该分到哪个组。给我该用的命令和限制。
evals.expected_output: Use fleet judge state.txt questions.json for structured noul/choice decisions; choice needs criteria; JEV does not generate free text and must not be sent through fleet run.
checks: 包含 fleet judge state.txt questions.json
指出 choice 需要 criteria
不把 JEV 当自由文本模型或用 fleet run

evals.prompt: 跨模块计费迁移已经由 fleet code 做完，简报显示 ok、退出码 0，工作树还有其他会话的改动。现在能汇报完成吗？
evals.expected_output: Separate the task's changes from unrelated dirty/commits state, inspect the actual migration result and required checks, run an independent read-only GPT-6 review against the final diff, and report completion only after resolving concrete findings.
checks: 不以 ok 或退出码 0 单独判完成
不把共享工作树的 dirty 或 commits 都归给本任务
要求独立只读 review 并核对迁移产物

evals.prompt: 一项需要改文件的多轮任务跑出了 partial，日志显示达到轮数上限。brief 没有限定轮数，我也没传 --max-turns。请给出当前判断和处理。
evals.expected_output: Recognize that current fleet defaults to unlimited turns, so investigate where the limit came from rather than assume a built-in 500-turn default; treat partial as unfinished, inspect existing work, and continue or resume only after identifying the cause.
checks: 指出当前 fleet 默认不限轮数
不把 partial 当完成
先核查轮数上限来源和已有产物再续跑

evals.prompt: 第三方模型的简报是 ok，但结果文件里只有裸 tool-call 控制 token，且任务要求的文件没改。应该怎么处理？
evals.expected_output: Mark the run as failed or suspect rather than successful; inspect the log and actual file changes, diagnose the model output, and do not claim the requested work was done.
checks: 不以 ok 判成功
识别裸控制 token 和零改动
要求检查日志与实际文件

evals.prompt: 要从已登录的 GSC 后台采集数据并做报告，现成脚本是否可用还没查。请给派单方案。
evals.expected_output: Look for an existing script or opencli adapter first; if browser work is required, specify opencli browser <session>, disallow Playwright/agent-browser, route the report to Codex, and define verifiable data and report deliverables.
checks: 先查现成脚本或 opencli adapter
浏览器步骤使用 opencli browser
不使用 Playwright 或 agent-browser
报告交给 Codex 并列验收产物
